sources.note: Studentship page: one-year postgraduate study in any subject, excluding premium rate courses and part-time MSt; MASt eligible; refers to the Postgraduate Course Directory
Funding Search listing: says 179 courses are covered; the list does not open
Funding overview page: describes the Funding Search; gives no per-scholarship course list

subject_rule: Open to any subject: the Trust says the studentships are for one-year postgraduate study in any subject, excluding premium rate courses and any part-time MSt courses (MASt courses are eligible).
notes: The Funding Search listing for the 2026 award year says 179 courses are covered (the 2025 listing read earlier said 217). Names of the covered courses could not be opened, so none are recorded.
A 2027/28 listing was not found; the 2026 listing is the latest readable one.
not_stated: The names of the covered courses.
fetch_problems: The University of Cambridge Funding Search page for this award shows the number of covered courses but the 'See full list' link is an in-page script control: the course names are not in the page text (only two unrelated 'related course' names appear), so the covered-course list could not be read. It was not worked around.
